Sailor.description: A student, instructor or member of the sailing school. A first name alone is not an identity.

Boat.description: A dinghy or keelboat used by the school, whoever owns or sails it.

Crewing.description:
Who stands in which post toward a boat: the skipper at the helm, crew aboard, or the owner.
Skippering a boat is not owning it.

Instruction.description: A teaching tie between two sailors: one teaches the other, or examines them for a ticket.

Lesson.description: One time on the water for a student. student is learning, taught_by teaches aboard, safety_cover drives the rescue boat.

DamageReport.description: Damage found on a boat: what it is, how serious, and how long the repair takes.

questions.q: Who is the owner of Saltwhistle?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Boat)-[:owner]->(n1:Sailor) WHERE n0.hull_name = 'Saltwhistle' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: Who is the skipper of Gannet?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Boat)-[:skipper]->(n1:Sailor) WHERE n0.hull_name = 'Gannet' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: Which boats are in my fleet?
questions.speaker: nikolai
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sailor)-[:fleet]->(n1:Boat) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.hull_name AS hull_name

questions.speaker: hana
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sailor)-[:instructor]->(n1:Sailor) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: Who is the pupil of Mateus Ferraz?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sailor)-[:pupil]->(n1:Sailor) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Mateus Ferraz' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: Who is the examiner of Bongani Zulu?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sailor)-[:examiner]->(n1:Sailor) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Bongani Zulu' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: Is there a record of a lifejacket check for the lessons of Leilani Kahale?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sailor)<-[:student]-(n1:Lesson) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Leilani Kahale' RETURN coalesce(n1.lifejacket_checked, false) AS lifejacket_checked

questions.q: Were lifejackets checked on the lessons of Hana Kobayashi?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sailor)<-[:student]-(n1:Lesson) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Hana Kobayashi' RETURN n1.lifejacket_checked AS lifejacket_checked

questions.q: What wind did my lessons have?
questions.speaker: hana
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sailor)<-[:student]-(n1:Lesson) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.wind_knots AS wind_knots

questions.q: Who drove the safety boat on lessons taught by Mateus Ferraz?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sailor)<-[:taught_by]-(n1:Lesson)-[:safety_cover]->(n2:Sailor) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Mateus Ferraz' RETURN n2.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: How many repair hours does the damage on Gannet need?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Boat)<-[:hull]-(n1:DamageReport) WHERE n0.hull_name = 'Gannet' RETURN n1.repair_hours AS repair_hours

questions.q: How severe is the damage to the rudder?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:DamageReport) WHERE n0.defect CONTAINS 'rudder' RETURN n0.severity AS severity
MATCH (n0:DamageReport)-[:reported_by]->(n1:Sailor) WHERE n0.defect = 'scratched gelcoat' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: What is Hana Kobayashi's licence code?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sailor) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Hana Kobayashi' RETURN n0.licence_code AS licence_code

questions.q: What state was the lesson with the reefing debrief in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Lesson) WHERE n0.debrief CONTAINS 'reefing' RETURN n0.state AS state
